🚨🎙️| Raphinha: “Ballon d’Or competition with Lamine? That’s something you guys (media) talk about; we don’t see it that way. I want him to achieve the best possible numbers and conquer everything in his career.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Raphinha: “I don’t just want to win the Champions League; I want to win every possible trophy until 2030.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Raphinha: “My goalscoring form as the '9'? It even surprised me. I never imagined scoring so many goals.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Raphinha: “Deco? When I arrived here, DECO was my agent. We had already been working together for seven years, and our friendship now goes back 10 years. Deco has been like a father to me and has done so much for me. He believed I could reach a club of this level long before I believed it myself. I don’t have an agent anymore; my wife and I manage my affairs. I have a fantastic relationship with Deco.” #fcblive
